data.body: Operator ruling 2026-09-07: Gerrit change 2801 is rejected as overreach because it violates the description cap's original intent. I abandoned 2801 with the requested message and am withdrawing that approach. The cap itself is intentional and must stand; the AC-correction trap on near-cap reviewed tickets still needs a properly scoped solution that does NOT weaken or bypass the cap. Open design direction for the next attempt: preserve the cap while adding a correction-safe path, for example an edit path that permits same-length or shrinking corrections, or an explicit re-review flow. No further implementation in this session.
